modules.title: Tech Module · Digital Identity Deep Dive
modules.summary: Understand your online footprint, secure accounts, and build intentional digital presence.
modules.objective: Participants evaluate and improve digital awareness, security, presence, and ownership.
lesson_points: Run digital awareness audit on publicly visible information.
Implement baseline security improvements and password hygiene.
Refine profile, bio, and resume for professional consistency.
Define ownership strategy for digital identity and long-term goals.
